name: Pochi
source:
A demon summoned by the protagonist. She has brown skin and red eyes. She is slender and has an androgynous appearance.

She is dressed like a detective assistant and has dog ears and a tail, but her ears and tail do not look like those of a normal human. Since the protagonist has stolen her true name and power, she is unable to do much in the human world.

Whenever she has the chance, she tries to outwit the protagonist, but it doesn't always work out.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=739032]getchu[/url]]
